name: SPARF
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields from Sparse and Noisy Poses
definition: A method for joint pose-NeRF training given few input images with noisy camera pose estimates, solving overfitting and geometric inconsistency by using multi-view correspondence and depth consistency losses.
summary: SPARF is a joint pose-NeRF training strategy that enables novel view synthesis from sparse, noisy inputs by enforcing multi-view geometry constraints rather than relying solely on photometric loss.
